tasks.behavior: Editor UI/UX phase 2: ordinary actions stop dead-ending. A blank document of every kind validates and builds a scene, a failed load explains itself and offers recovery, an open menu no longer swallows the next click, every kind the Add menu offers can actually be added, single-key shortcuts stay out of menus and dialogs, Import JSON works, and the chrome gets a complete token set, styled scrollbars, a visible focus ring on every field, resizable panes, and node padding that keeps titles off the card edge.
acceptance: blankDocument(kind) validates and builds a scene for all five document kinds.
A document that fails to load renders a recovery surface naming the failure with Return to library and Download, not a bare sentence.
An outside pointerdown closes a menu or listbox and still activates what was clicked; a modal dialog still swallows it.
Every node kind in addableKinds(kind) applies cleanly to a blank document of that kind.
commandForKeyEvent returns null inside editable targets, menus, listboxes and dialogs, on held keys, and on unintended Shift chords.
Import JSON in the command palette opens a file picker and loads the document.
Every COMMAND_ID appears in COMMANDS and is dispatched by the editor.
Radius, type-scale, z-index, motion and control-size tokens are defined once and used by the chrome.
Every scroll container uses the app's own scrollbar styling in both themes.
Every text field and select trigger shows a visible focus ring and shares one height, padding and background.
The outline and inspector panes can be resized and persist their width.
Node titles keep a padding gap from the card edge in the editor and in every export.

tasks.behavior: Editor UI/UX phase 3: editing is predictable and the interface says where to click. React Flow's node changes pass through so its store and the editor agree on selection, a new node lands in view with the selection's group and opens for renaming, a rejected edit has one dismissible home that says what to do, an empty canvas names its gestures, and New, the theme and the panes are reachable without opening a menu first.
acceptance: Clicking a node card selects it, and renaming through the inspector keeps that selection.
Five components added in a row all land inside the canvas viewport and none overlaps another.
A new node joins the group of the current selection and opens its label editor.
Every prop passed to React Flow keeps a stable identity across renders.
A rejected edit appears once, carries guidance for the rule it broke, and can be dismissed.
An empty canvas names rename, connect, arrange and the command menu.
New has a visible control at full header width and the theme can be switched without the command menu.
The Outline and Details controls are reachable at every shell layout below split.
Advertised shortcut glyphs come from COMMANDS in every surface that shows them.
The undo stack is bounded.
